name: Starcut
description: Two ink layers: a star cut to a disc, over a ring that runs round outside it.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 45deg, 90deg, 135deg, 180deg, 225deg, 270deg, 315deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--color1); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 42%, #000 42% 50%, transparent 50%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 42%, #000 42% 50%, transparent 50%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(50.0% 4.0%, 61.2% 34.6%, 93.7% 35.8%, 68.1% 55.9%, 77.0% 87.2%, 50.0% 69.0%, 23.0% 87.2%, 31.9% 55.9%, 6.3% 35.8%, 38.8% 34.6%); clip-path: polygon(50.0% 4.0%, 61.2% 34.6%, 93.7% 35.8%, 68.1% 55.9%, 77.0% 87.2%, 50.0% 69.0%, 23.0% 87.2%, 31.9% 55.9%, 6.3% 35.8%, 38.8% 34.6%); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, #000 40%, transparent 40%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, #000 40%, transparent 40%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
